name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; accurately names a per-tick state machine for the main (12-slot) summon-spell animation. 'main' distinguishes it from the minor/variant-a..e sibling tick fns in the same file. No address residue (the 0x26795 appears only as a location tag in comments, not in the name).
purpose: Per-tick state machine that drives the main 12-slot summon-spell animation; dispatch-table entry #3.
logic_summary: memcpy's three rodata tables into locals each call: per-slot y offsets (12 x int32 from 0x52460), per-color vertical offsets (12 x uint8 from 0x52490), per-color sprite/SFX-mask offsets (12 x uint8 from 0x5249C). Reads the caster's runtime_char.bTeam (offset 6); if bTeam==0 (enemy) adds 0x14 to every local y offset. Switches on state_code: state 0 (INIT) seeds each of 12 slots frame_counter[i]=-2*i (staggered start) and color_idx[i]=i, sets color_rotation_counter=12, clears terminate_flag and odd/even toggle, returns 2; state 3 returns 0x28 (40-tick hold); state 6 sets terminate_flag (stops color rotation) and returns 0x14. States 2/5/8 (TICK) flip the mod-2 odd/even toggle, then for each of 12 slots: if 0<=frame<0xB blit (color-indexed sprite offset + frame) at origin_y + y_offsets[color] - v_offsets[color]*row_stride; and on even ticks only advance the frame counter, play a frame-0 chime when the color's SFX-mask byte is nonzero, set done_flag at frame 3 (also a frame-3 chime when the mask byte is zero), and at frame 0xB (unless terminate_flag) advance color_rotation_counter mod 12 into this slot's color index and restart its frame counter at 0. The TICK path returns done_flag. All other states return 0.
signature: int __cdecl fd2_tick_summon_spell_main_animation_state(int caster_unit_id, int sprite_handle, int origin_y, int row_stride, char state_code)

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Index of the casting unit into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr; used to read bTeam (offset 6) to decide the enemy-team y-offset shift.
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate; no address residue.

params.name: sprite_handle
params.semantics: Sprite atlas/sheet handle forwarded to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite for every slot blit.
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate; matches the canonical name used by all sibling tick fns. (Ghidra's decompiler internally labels this param sprite_param5, which is a decompiler artifact, not the src name.)

params.name: origin_y
params.semantics: Base Y origin for the blits; each slot renders at origin_y + y_offsets[color] - v_offsets[color]*row_stride.

params.name: row_stride
params.semantics: Per-row pixel/byte stride, used both as a vertical scaling factor (v_offsets[color]*row_stride) and as the blit row-stride argument.

params.name: state_code
params.semantics: Animation phase selector dispatched by the switch (0,2,3,5,6,8 are handled; others return 0).
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate; no address residue.

returns.semantics: Frame-hold / status code consumed by the caller's dispatch loop: 2 (state 0 init), 0x28 (state 3), 0x14 (state 6), and done_flag from the TICK path (1 once any slot's frame counter reaches 3, else 0); 0 for all other states.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment block was correct but terse: it gave only the dispatch-table index, the mod-12 color rotation, the odd/even toggle, and the three rodata tables, omitting the per-state behavior (INIT seeding, state 3/6 holds, the TICK blit + SFX + color-rotation logic) and the enemy-team y-offset adjustment.
notes: Sole xref is DATA from 0x523C5 (dispatch table base 0x523B9, entry index 3 = +0xC), matching the plate; no direct CALL callers. bTeam==0 = enemy team per overview.md runtime_char layout (bTeam at offset 6), consistent with sibling shard 00026528. Decompilation and src are behaviorally identical: the odd/even update (X+1 then %2 in decompile) equals src (toggle+1)%2; the done_flag at frame==3 is unconditional in both (the spr_offsets[color]==0 branch only gates the second chime); the team adjust applies to the local y-offset copy only. No logic touched. Signature recorded as it appears in Ghidra (int params + char state_code); src declares uint32 params -- a type-width difference only, not changed here (rule: no signature/type edits). Plate is detailed, accurate, and consistent with the refined understanding, so it is left as-is.
